# Advantiko

> > Advantiko is a multilingual travel guide platform providing detailed destination guides, transportation advice, and accommodation recommendations across Asia, Europe, and North America.

The site offers comprehensive travel resources in multiple languages (English, French, Russian) covering major tourist destinations including Thailand, China, Japan, South Korea, Czech Republic, France, USA, and more. Content focuses on practical travel planning with detailed guides to attractions, transportation options, hotel recommendations, and UNESCO World Heritage sites.

## Key Topics

- Travel guides and destination planning
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Transportation guides (flights, ferries, trains)
- Bangkok and Koh Samui travel
- Thailand island destinations
- Prague cultural attractions
- Beijing and Chinese landmarks
- Family-friendly hotels and resorts
- Theme parks and entertainment venues
- Historical palaces and castles
- Budget and luxury accommodation
- Airport transfers and city transport
- Day tours and excursions
- Southeast Asian travel
- European city tourism

- [How to Get from Bangkok to Koh Samui: 3 Best Ways in 2025](https://advantiko.com/en/countries/thailand-en/getting-from-bangkok-to-koh-samui): Transportation guide: Bangkok to Koh Samui via flights, ferry & bus
- [Аэропорт Пекина: Как Добраться до Центра Города (2024)](https://advantiko.com/countries/china/kak-dobratsia-is-aeroporta-pekina): Beijing airport transfer guide from Shoudu Airport to city center
- [Как Добраться с Самуи на Ко Тао: Где Купить Билеты на Паром](https://advantiko.com/countries/thailand/kak-dobratsia-iz-samui-na-ko-tao): Koh Samui to Koh Tao ferry guide with ticket booking info
- [How to Get from Chengdu to Beijing by Train and Plane (2024)](https://advantiko.com/en/countries/china-en/how-to-get-from-chengdu-to-beijing): Chengdu to Beijing travel via high-speed rail & flights

- [Дворец Версаль во Франции: Цена Билетов, Экскурсии](https://advantiko.com/countries/france/dvorec-versailles-vo-francii): Versailles Palace visitor guide: tickets, tours & Louis XIV history
